criteria.title: 시간·공간 cutoff 선택
criteria.text:
q≤C0(τ+|z|^(1/D))로support를q<q*/2 안에놓고c=χxχt를선택한다. χx는r²,z에smooth하게둔다. 합격: u=p=0인
초기시간구간과고정compact K가존재한다. t가1에가까울때원점근방에서cutoff가정확히1이어야한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Complete N6 local A,B,p and its original qstar.
Apply the fixed compact cutoff and verify the initial zero interval and exact unit cutoff near the origin with actual source constants.
remainingObligations: Complete N6 local A,B,p and its original qstar.
Apply the fixed compact cutoff and verify the initial zero interval and exact unit cutoff near the origin with actual source constants.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The explicit cutoff-support inequality and smooth r^2/z recipe remain executable. The new selected N6 pressure/signed construction is not a final local A,B,p sum, so it does not yet supply the original qstar, compact K or initial zero interval.

criteria.title: Localization 교차항 보존
criteria.text:
(10.4)의curl(cA), 특히∇c×A를포함하고f를전체PDE residual로정의한다. 합격: 직접계산된f와cutoff 전residual+모
든commutator 전개의일치여부를검사한다. ∇·u=0은구조적으로유지한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Localize the complete actual N6 potentials and pressure.
Evaluate full f and all cutoff commutators independently on the same source, preserving structural divergence freedom and explicit error budgets.
remainingObligations: Localize the complete actual N6 potentials and pressure.
Evaluate full f and all cutoff commutators independently on the same source, preserving structural divergence freedom and explicit error budgets.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The curl(cA)=c curl A+grad(c) cross A contract still retains every cutoff derivative. New source curls are pre-localization finite expressions; the complete localized source force and its independent commutator evaluation have not been produced.

criteria.title: Force의 발산과 압력 계약
criteria.text:
원문p118에따라f는divergence-free일필요가없다. −Δp=∂i∂j(uiuj)−div f를검사한다. 합격: div f≠0을실패로처리하
지않는다. 임의Leray projection으로f를바꿔compact support/pressure 조건을훼손하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Verify the pressure identity for the exact same localized actual force and full source velocity.
Retain its forcing, support and pressure assumptions without applying an arbitrary force projection.
remainingObligations: Verify the pressure identity for the exact same localized actual force and full source velocity.
Retain its forcing, support and pressure assumptions without applying an arbitrary force projection.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The actual initial source pressure now retains the auxiliary radial remainder. Separately, the localization contract and finite periodic tests preserve -Delta p=partial_i partial_j(ui uj)-div f and allow nonzero div f. A complete localized source force has not yet been used in that identity.

criteria.title: Terminal force jets
criteria.text:
Fj(x)=lim(t↑1)∂t^j f(x,t), ∂x^αFj(0)=0을(10.6)-(10.10)에맞춰구축한다. 합격: 유한jet order M의수치근사와∀order
smooth-extension 정리의의존성을분리한다. 몇개finite differences가작다는이유로C∞force라표시하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Construct Fj from the complete actual localized residual as t approaches1.
Prove the original differentiated terminal limits and origin flatness for every required spatial/time order.
remainingObligations: Construct Fj from the complete actual localized residual as t approaches1.
Prove the original differentiated terminal limits and origin flatness for every required spatial/time order.
criteria.acceptanceScope: C4/C5 jets of the original pulse ODE are now actually constructed. They are slow pulse coefficient derivatives on a selected interior chart, not terminal time jets of the localized residual. No all-order terminal extension or flatness at the origin is inferred.

criteria.title: t>1 force extension
criteria.text:
(10.11)의Σχ0(bjσ)σ^jFj/j!, σ=t−1≥0를사용하며(10.12)의differentiated tail constraints로bj를선택한다. 합격:
force는t≤2에서compact support를갖고모든인증된jets가접합된다. 이는velocity를t=1 이후smooth하게연장하는
알고리즘이아니다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Supply the actual terminal jets and certified derivative constants.
Bind the complete differentiated infinite tail, compact support and all certified jet joins through t=2.
remainingObligations: Supply the actual terminal jets and certified derivative constants.
Bind the complete differentiated infinite tail, compact support and all certified jet joins through t=2.
criteria.acceptanceScope: A finite conditional input of jet bounds still produces increasing bj satisfying the declared differentiated cutoff constraints. The real source terminal Fj sequence and its complete infinite tail are absent, so compact all-order extension through t=2 is not claimed.

criteria.title: 전역 에너지 balance
criteria.text:
d(∥u∥²₂/2)/dt+ν∥∇u∥²₂=⟨f,u⟩를전체K에서적분한다. core만의에너지와구분한다. 합격: 정규화energy defect가
독립space/time refinement에서감소한다. ν=1에서(10.13)의∥u(t)∥²₂+2∫∥∇u∥²₂≤(∫∥f∥₂)² 상계와모순없어야
한다.
criteria.assessedBy: MathScope actual source and finite observation review
remaining: Evaluate energy and force work for the actual localized source on all of K.
Refine its space and time independently and establish consistency with the original nu=1 force-norm bound (10.13).
remainingObligations: Evaluate energy and force work for the actual localized source on all of K.
Refine its space and time independently and establish consistency with the original nu=1 force-norm bound (10.13).
criteria.acceptanceScope: The separate periodic Galerkin observation layer now distinguishes physical whole-box energy integrals from a fixed user-defined core box, with independent midpoint refinement and time-integration evidence. It does not integrate the localized paper field and force on the required compact K.

criteria.title: 실제 blowup 경로와 오차
criteria.text:
xτ=(√(2Xinτ),0,0), η=0에서τ^A uθ=e0+O(τ^(2h)), e0>0를측정한다. 합격: e0의양의하한과remainder의explicit
bound가있어야해석적성장certificate로연결한다. 유한값plot의증가만으로τ→0의무한대를증명하지않는다.
criteria.assessedBy: Actual source constructor, independent Fraction check, CI artifact and public v97 scope review
remaining: Construct/apply the complete original final N6 instance and its same-source annular-support/domain identity at the Xin path; do not replace this with arbitrary sampled data.
Discharge the explicit Proposition9.9/10.1 final-localized-field identification bridge before promoting the original N7-07 criterion or an unconditional final-field growth certificate.
remainingObligations: Construct/apply the complete original final N6 instance and its same-source annular-support/domain identity at the Xin path; do not replace this with arbitrary sampled data.
Discharge the explicit Proposition9.9/10.1 final-localized-field identification bridge before promoting the original N7-07 criterion or an unconditional final-field growth certificate.
criteria.acceptanceScope: The actual original M2 background inner path was reconstructed: same common source family, a fresh exact Phi(2,0)>1/2 enclosure, e0>1/(CSelected*sqrt(Lambda))>0 and an explicit all-order C*tau^(2h) remainder with positive domain/scale retained as exact expressions. Local and actual CI constructor artifacts are byte-identical. Public v97 verifies five exact outward normalized intervals, source selection, full28966-node scalar DAG export and archive replay. Identification with the final localized field remains CONDITIONAL_ON_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_THEOREM_IDENTIFICATION (Propositions9.9/10.1). The original certificate originalN7CriterionComplete=false and whole final N6 construction=false are preserved; UI success alone does not complete this original criterion.
